product.title: Private Surf Lessons in Honolulu

description.text: Hawaii is the perfect to learn to surf, and the perfect *way* is with a pro who's chased waves for 18 years on the world circuit. Unlike crowded tourist lessons, these private sessions match your skill level, from first-timers mastering the basics to experienced riders fine-tuning technique. With all gear provided, you’re guaranteed to improve your skills with 1-1 instruction—and hopefully have a great time in the waves.Surfboard and waterproof gear provided Get 1-1 access to a local surfing pro who can address your needs Suitable for most all ages and fitness levels, including younger kids Li Ideal for travelers basing in Honolulu who want a guided Oahu experience without coordinating transport, gear, or admission tickets on their own.
